page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-60-lssd is a memory-optimized and storage-equipped virtual server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor on the x86_64 architecture. The instance delivers 60 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 30 physical cores with two threads per core. The CPU configuration features 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache, alongside support for AVX-512 vector extensions, including AVX-512 VNNI and BF16, and hardware-accelerated cryptographic instructions such as AES, VAES, and SHA-NI.

Memory capacity is configured at 480.0 GB, providing an 8.0 GB memory-to-vCPU allocation ratio. Local storage is directly integrated, consisting of four NVMe solid-state drives totaling 1608 GB of capacity. The configuration does not include discrete graphics processing units, relying entirely on CPU execution for compute and vector workloads, and is provisioned without complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark evaluation shows top-quartile performance across parallel execution and memory-bound operations. Multi-core compute performance is demonstrated by a stress-ng multi-core score of 86080.44 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 18167.0, complemented by a Clang software compilation score of 50355.0. Data-intensive memory execution achieves 78.41 million operations per second in Redis SET tests and a PassMark database score of 26296.65. Uncached large-block memory read bandwidth reaches 144.14 GB/sec, while single-core Geekbench execution scores 1878.0, placing single-thread throughput within the median category.

The dense balance of 480 GB system memory, high core count, and fast local NVMe storage makes this instance technically suited for large relational databases, in-memory caching platforms such as Redis, intermediate ETL staging pipelines, and software compilation tasks that benefit from dedicated hardware threads and fast local temporary storage.
